commit_subject: hip : preserve Qwen4Exp MTP decode numerics

environment.rocm_device: AMD Radeon Graphics (63972 MiB, 63968 MiB free)

commands.label: build-hip
commands.command: cmake --build build-hip --config Release -j 32 --target llama-bench llama-perplexity test-backend-ops

commands.label: build-vulkan
commands.command: cmake --build build-vulkan --config Release -j 32 --target llama-bench llama-perplexity test-backend-ops

commands.label: llama-bench-qwen36-35b-a3b
